Completed intent i022 (media-epidx, snapshot s06) with 6 findings and 12 classified candidates in /mnt/raid/home/yangshuangning/vuln_variant_search/experiments/clairvoyant_variant_search/runs/10_cluster/C8/agent-state/findings/i022.json.

FINDINGS (all with literal source quotes and exact line ranges):
1. HIGH s06:drivers/media/usb/gspca/stv06xx/stv06xx.c:318-345 — stv06xx_isoc_init/isoc_nego take actconfig->intf_cache[0]->altsetting[1] (literal 1) then read AND WRITE alt->endpoint[0].desc.wMaxPacketSize (lines 321-322, 334, 342) with no num_altsetting>=2 and no bNumEndpoints>=1 check anywhere in the file; hooks fire from gspca_init_transfer (gspca.c:852-853, 957-958) at VIDIOC_STREAMON. OOB 16-bit read/write past the cached descriptor flex arrays against an attacker-controlled gadget spoofing stv06xx VID/PIDs. The f002 pattern is confirmed still present in s06's gspca tree.
2. HIGH s06:drivers/media/usb/gspca/xirlink_cit.c:2651-2688 — sd_isoc_init/sd_isoc_nego copy the same intf_cache[0]->altsetting[1].endpoint[0] wMaxPacketSize read/write pattern (2653-2654, 2676-2684) then usb_set_interface(dev, iface, 1); zero bNumEndpoints/num_altsetting references in the file.
3. HIGH s06:drivers/media/usb/usbvision/usbvision-video.c:1497-1508 — probe loop over uif->num_altsetting reads uif->altsetting[i].endpoint[1].desc.wMaxPacketSize per iteration with no per-altsetting bNumEndpoints>1 check; the only check (line 1453) covers a different interface object; result feeds usbvision->alt_max_pkt_size[] — the seed's exact wMaxPacketSize-derived alt_max_pkt_size consequence at plug-in.
4. MEDIUM s06:drivers/media/usb/dvb-usb/dib0700_core.c:826-841 — dib0700_rc_setup (probe, line 891) reads e = &intf->altsetting[0].endpoint[rc_ep].desc with rc_ep=1 and no bNumEndpoints check in the file; gated only by attacker-satisfiable fw_version >= 0x10200; OOB descriptor fields program usb_rcvbulk/intpipe.
5. MEDIUM s06:drivers/media/usb/b2c2/flexcop-usb.c:427-432 — flexcop_usb_transfer_init (probe chain) reads cur_altsetting->endpoint[0].desc.wMaxPacketSize with no bNumEndpoints validation in the driver; frame_size sizes the coherent iso buffer and per-URB lengths.
6. MEDIUM s06:drivers/media/usb/gspca/konica.c:202-214 — sd_start URB loop uses i = n&1?0:1, reading alt->endpoint[1].desc.wMaxPacketSize with no bNumEndpoints in the file; core alt_xfer guarantees only >=1 endpoint, so index 1 is unvalidated; packet_size sizes usb_alloc_coherent buffers.

SAFE (evidence-backed negatives): usbtv-core.c:82 (num_altsetting!=2 and bNumEndpoints!=4 rejected first), uvc_driver.c:1281 (guarded by bNumEndpoints==1 at 1279), em28xx-cards.c:3486, em28xx-audio.c:770, stk1160-core.c:199, tm6000-cards.c:1251, smsusb.c:439/532/604 (all loop-bounded by bNumEndpoints), au0828-video.c:1934, stv06xx_pb0100.c:197 (index 0 covered by core >=1 guarantee). UNRESOLVED: xirlink_cit.c:1454 (cit_get_packet_size endpoint[0], NULL-check status unverified). cx231xx files excluded as seed family.

LIMITATIONS: no compile/run reproduction (read-only snapshot, static hypotheses); stv06xx/xirlink findings conflate altsetting-count (if-alt-count branch i025) and endpoint-count halves and need dedupe at merge; OOB memory target for zero-endpoint altsettings depends on usbcore's conditional endpoint-array allocation; trigger paths source-traced only.
